text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal!! What an unbelievable race!!
What a magnificent festival this has been!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume gave it her all!
Truly a nail-biting, fiercely contested race!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle dazzled us just like she always does!
I'm sure this was quite a valuable experience for the rising star Neo Universe as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good work~, Universe-chan.
Man, I was so nervous, but that was really fun~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: How'd it go on your end? Well, I guess I did what I could in my own way too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――“KELT”。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""KELT"... isn't it?
The mantle's formative layer is... different."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe says.
Hishi Miracle is... a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Receiving this "solar wind"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that's tricky... Um... In other words...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess that means you're praising me!
That part's right, isn't it? Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! That Hishi Miracle and
Universe are...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They are completely on the same wavelength!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The emotion! The divinity! The ultimate double dose!!
This is it, this is what Digi-tan and the fans have been craving!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "connections" are... "expanding"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "Veil Nebula"... Like delicate threads, connecting to each and every person...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Neo Universe!
For running in the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, that was so much fun!!!!
Neo Uni is the best!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the cheers echoing at my back,
I rush over to Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Good work, the crowd was totally hyped up!
Good work, the crowd was totally hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe……wanted to do this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes... I wanted to do something "fun".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just other Umamusume we 'connect' with.
When that thin 'REEN' bursts into the sky—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Everyone will become "fun and interesting."
choice_data_list: I see. You just wanted to entertain everyone.
Right, you just wanted to entertain everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to entertain people who love
Umamusume, just like Agnes Digital does.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps that is the evolved form
of the 'connection' that quietly
sprouted within Neo Universe."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The smile of "MAZN"...
Very... very..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphira—right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Takarazuka Kinen came to an end,
and Neo Universe returned to the original Classic Road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Next is the Kikuka Sho. It'll be a touchstone race to see how far we can go over long distances, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to make autumn "interesting" just like this time, too...
But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I can't see past the Kikuka-sho.
Yet another... barrier...
